sources.note: Urton & Chu, Appendix I: Inventory of Inkawasi Khipus. UR260's only named partner is UR259 (physical tie); UR259 row: 'All values 4 or below. Tied to UR260'. The inventory covers Inkawasi only; 'Leymebamba' does not occur in it; UR004 is not listed.

Urton & Chu 2015, Latin American Antiquity 26(4) (KFG cites pp. 519-520 for UR260). Redirects to the /abs/ abstract page (HTTP 200); full text not accessible, so pp. 519-520 were not read. Unresolved.
Urton 2006, Revista Andina 42:153-196 (KFG cites p. 188 for UR004). Dialnet record page: 'Texto completo no disponible'. Unresolved.

Urton 2004, 'Concordancias y afinidades en archivos de registros de khipus procedentes de Chachapoyas e Ica, Peru', Boletin de Arqueologia PUCP 8:289-303 (a paper on matching accounts, found by web search; not in KFG's KH0240 bibliography). Download, article view, DOI (10.18800/boletindearqueologiapucp.200401.015) and repositorio item all return an Anubis 'Making sure you're not a bot!' proof-of-work page to curl and WebFetch; the repository API lists 0 bundles. Not read; a search-engine snippet of it is not used as evidence. It predates the Inkawasi excavations (Appendix I project numbers carry 2013-2014), so it could not have named UR260 in any case. Unresolved for UR004.
